about: Second Timothy is Paul's last letter to Timothy, asking him to stay faithful.

pages.title: A Faith Passed Down
pages.scene: A grandmother and mother reading to a boy
pages.text: Timothy's grandma Lois and his mom Eunice loved God. They taught Timothy the Scriptures since he was little. Paul wrote, "God's word is breathed out by God. It teaches us and helps us do good."
pages.lesson: Learn God's word, and share it with your family.
